# Pendahuluan

Dokumen ini adalah notebook R Markdown berjudul "Trade-off Analysis (TA) Ekonomi Regional".

Mode saat ini: `r params$mode`
Jumlah skenario: `r params$n_scenarios`

Mode BAU: Proyeksi baseline + generate template untuk `r params$n_scenarios` skenario.

Mode Scenario: Proyeksi dengan `r params$n_scenarios` skenario intervensi + komparasi.

## Daftar Isi

1. [Analisis Deskriptif](#analisis-deskriptif)
2. [Proyeksi](#proyeksi)

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# 1. KONFIGURASI INPUT
# =====================================================

## Mandatory
descriptive_analysis_table <- "data/IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx"
projection_area_file <- "data/table/luc_projection.xlsx"
initial_year <- 2024
end_year <- 2049
time_step <- 5
n_scenarios <- params$n_scenarios

## Optional — otomatis NULL jika mode = "BAU"
if (params$mode == "BAU") {
  scenario_inputs <- NULL
} else {
  scenario_inputs <- list()
  for (s in 1:n_scenarios) {
    scenario_inputs[[s]] <- list(
      name = paste0("Skenario_", s),
      land_distribution = paste0("data/scenario/scenario", s, "/distribusi_lahan.xlsx"),
      growth_rate       = paste0("data/scenario/scenario", s, "/growth_rate.xlsx"),
      lpc               = paste0("data/scenario/scenario", s, "/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx"),
      io_changes        = paste0("data/scenario/scenario", s, "/perubahan_io.xlsx"),
      intensity         = paste0("data/scenario/scenario", s, "/intensitas.xlsx")
    )
  }
}

# =====================================================
# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# =====================================================

read_sheet <- function(path, sheet) {
  readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet) |> as.data.frame()
}

create_period_table <- function(initial_year, end_year, time_step) {
  start_year <- seq(initial_year, end_year - time_step, by = time_step)
  end_period <- start_year + time_step
  data.frame(
    Period = paste0(start_year, "-", end_period),
    Start_Year = start_year,
    End_Year = end_period,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gdp_baseline <- read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "GDP")
gdp_baseline <- gdp_baseline |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GDP = as.numeric(GDP),
    OUTPUT = as.numeric(OUTPUT),
    FD = as.numeric(FD),

  )

gdp_baseline$Sector_Code <- 1:nrow(gdp_baseline)

leontief_matrix <- as.matrix(
  readxl::read_excel(descriptive_analysis_table, sheet = "Leontief_Matrix", col_names = FALSE)
)

full_io_df <- readxl::read_excel(descriptive_analysis_table, sheet = "Full_IO_Table")
full_io_table <- as.matrix(full_io_df[, -1])
storage.mode(full_io_table) <- "numeric"

code_registry <- readxl::read_excel(descriptive_analysis_table, sheet = "Code_Registry")
sector_idx <- code_registry$Row_Index[code_registry$Type == "Sector"]

income_multiplier   <- read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "Multiplier_Income")
labour_multiplier   <- read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "Multiplier_Labour")
SUB_multiplier      <- read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "Multiplier_SUB")
output_multiplier   <- read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "Multiplier_Output")
linkage_table       <- read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "Linkage")

land_prop <- readxl::read_excel(descriptive_analysis_table, sheet = "Land_Proportion")
projection_area <- readxl::read_excel(projection_area_file) |> as.data.frame()

# Growth rate default
growth_rate <- tryCatch(
  read_sheet(descriptive_analysis_table, "Growth_Rate"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

# Land proportion default

storage.mode(P_default) <- "numeric"
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# 4. FUNGSI-FUNGSI SKENARIO
# =====================================================

calculate_lpc_growth_rate <- function(lpc_scenario, sector, period_idx, periods_df) {
  if (is.null(lpc_scenario)) return(0)
  
  sub <- lpc_scenario[
    lpc_scenario$Sector_Code == sector &
    lpc_scenario$Start_Year <= periods_df$End_Year[period_idx],
  ]
  
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(0)
  
  crop_type <- sub$Crop_Type[1]
  
  if (crop_type == "annual") {
    row_now <- sub[sub$Start_Year == periods_df$Start_Year[period_idx], ]
    if (nrow(row_now) == 0) return(0)
    return(row_now$Increment_Rate * row_now$Area_Implemented)
  } else {
    area_now <- sub$Area_Implemented[nrow(sub)]
    total <- sum(sub$Increment_Rate * area_now)
    return(total)
  }
}

apply_io_changes <- function(full_io_table, io_changes, period_start, period_end) {
  if (is.null(io_changes)) return(full_io_table)
  
  changes_period <- io_changes[
    io_changes$Start_Year == period_start &
    io_changes$End_Year == period_end,
  ]
  
  if (nrow(changes_period) == 0) return(full_io_table)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(changes_period))) {
    r <- changes_period$Row_Code[i]
    c <- changes_period$Col_Code[i]
    pct <- changes_period$Change_Pct[i]
    full_io_table[r, c] <- full_io_table[r, c] * (1 + pct)
  }
  
  return(full_io_table)
}

recalculate_leontief <- function(full_io_table, sector_idx, output_total) {
  intermediate <- full_io_table[sector_idx, sector_idx, drop = FALSE]
  A <- sweep(intermediate, 2, output_total, "/")
  A[!is.finite(A)] <- 0
  I <- diag(nrow(A))
  L <- solve(I - A)
  return(L)
}

get_intensity <- function(intensity_table, sector, period_start, period_end) {
  if (is.null(intensity_table)) return(1.0)
  
  row <- intensity_table[
    intensity_table$Sector_Code == sector &
    intensity_table$Start_Year == period_start &
    intensity_table$End_Year == period_end,
  ]
  
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(1.0)
  return(row$Intensity[1])
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# 5. FUNGSI PROYEKSI UTAMA
# =====================================================

run_projection <- function(
    gdp_baseline,
    income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier,
    linkage_table,
    leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table,
    sector_idx,
    P,
    area_matrix,
    growth_rate,
    lpc_scenario = NULL,
    io_changes = NULL,
    intensity_table = NULL
) {
  
  years <- as.numeric(colnames(area_matrix))
  years <- sort(years)
  
  if (length(years) > 1) {
    time_step <- years[2] - years[1]
  }
  
  periods_df <- create_period_table(
    initial_year = years[1] - time_step,
    end_year = years[length(years)],
    time_step = time_step
  )
  
  # Baseline values
  current_prop_fd   <- as.numeric(gdp_baseline$Prop_FD)
  current_lpc       <- as.numeric(gdp_baseline$LPC)
  output_baseline   <- as.numeric(gdp_baseline$OUTPUT)
  gdp_prop          <- as.numeric(gdp_baseline$GDP_PROP)
  income_coeff      <- as.numeric(income_multiplier$Inc.multiplier)
  labour_coeff      <- as.numeric(labour_multiplier$Lab.multiplier)
  labour_compensation <- as.numeric(labour_multiplier$Labour_Compensation)
  labour_baseline   <- as.numeric(labour_multiplier$Labour)
  sub_coeff         <- as.numeric(SUB_multiplier$SUB.multiplier)
  surplus_baseline  <- as.numeric(SUB_multiplier$Surplus)
  output_coeff      <- as.numeric(output_multiplier$Out.multiplier)
  itfl_coeff        <- linkage_table$ITFL
  itbl_coeff        <- linkage_table$ITBL
  
  # Growth rate handling
  if (!is.null(growth_rate) && ncol(growth_rate) >= 1) {
    r <- as.numeric(growth_rate[[1]])
  } else {
    r <- rep(0.03, nrow(gdp_baseline))
  }
  
  current_labour <- labour_baseline
  
  prop_labour <- output_baseline / labour_baseline
  prop_labour[!is.finite(prop_labour)] <- 0
  
  growth_factor <- (1 + r)^time_step
  
  previous_output <- output_baseline
  current_leontief <- leontief_matrix
  current_io_table <- full_io_table
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (yr_idx in seq_along(years)) {
    
    year <- years[yr_idx]
    
    period_row <- periods_df[periods_df$End_Year == year, ]
    if (nrow(period_row) == 0) next
    p_start <- period_row$Start_Year
    p_end   <- period_row$End_Year
    
    # IO Changes
    current_io_table <- apply_io_changes(current_io_table, io_changes, p_start, p_end)
    current_leontief <- recalculate_leontief(current_io_table, sector_idx, output_baseline)
    
    # Land Requirement
    area_t <- area_matrix[, as.character(year)]
    
    if (ncol(P) == length(area_t)) {
      land_req_t <- as.numeric(P %*% area_t)
    } else if (nrow(P) == length(area_t)) {
      land_req_t <- as.numeric(t(P) %*% area_t)
    } else {
      stop("Dimensi P tidak cocok dengan area_t")
    }
    land_req_t[land_req_t <= 0] <- NA
    
    # LPC Productivity
    if (!is.null(lpc_scenario)) {
      for (s in seq_along(current_lpc)) {
        sector_code <- gdp_baseline$Sector_Code[s]
        lpc_gr <- calculate_lpc_growth_rate(lpc_scenario, sector_code, yr_idx, periods_df)
        current_lpc[s] <- current_lpc[s] + (current_lpc[s] * lpc_gr)
      }
    }
    current_lpc[!is.finite(current_lpc)] <- 0
    
    # Final Demand
    fd_t <- land_req_t * current_prop_fd * current_lpc * growth_factor
    fd_t[is.na(fd_t)] <- 0
    
    # Intensity
    intensity_vec <- sapply(seq_along(fd_t), function(s) {
      get_intensity(intensity_table, gdp_baseline$Sector_Code[s], p_start, p_end)
    })
    
    fd_baseline <- as.numeric(gdp_baseline$FD)
    fd_effective <- fd_baseline + intensity_vec * (fd_t - fd_baseline)
    fd_effective[!is.finite(fd_effective)] <- 0
    fd_effective[fd_effective < 0] <- 0
    
    # Output
    output_t <- as.numeric(current_leontief %*% matrix(fd_effective))
    
    # GDP
    gdp_t <- output_t * gdp_prop
    
    # Income
    projected_compensation <- income_coeff * output_baseline
    prop_compensation <- labour_compensation / projected_compensation
    prop_compensation[!is.finite(prop_compensation)] <- 0
    income_t <- output_t * income_coeff * prop_compensation
    
    # Labour
    add <- (output_t / prop_labour) * labour_coeff
    add[!is.finite(add)] <- 0
    labour_t <- current_labour + add
    
    # Surplus
    projected_SUB <- sub_coeff * output_baseline
    prop_SUB <- surplus_baseline / projected_SUB
    prop_SUB[!is.finite(prop_SUB)] <- 0
    surplus_t <- output_t * sub_coeff * prop_SUB
    
    # Output Multiplier
    output_ratio <- output_t / previous_output
    output_ratio[!is.finite(output_ratio)] <- 1
    output_multiplier_t <- output_ratio * output_coeff
    
    # Land Linkage
    itfl_t <- itfl_coeff * (land_req_t / gdp_baseline$Land_Requirement)
    itbl_t <- itbl_coeff * (land_req_t / gdp_baseline$Land_Requirement)
    itfl_t[!is.finite(itfl_t)] <- 0
    itbl_t[!is.finite(itbl_t)] <- 0
    
    # Update for next period
    prop_fd_t <- fd_t / output_t
    prop_fd_t[!is.finite(prop_fd_t)] <- 0
    
    lpc_t <- output_t / land_req_t
    lpc_t[!is.finite(lpc_t)] <- 0
    
    current_prop_fd <- prop_fd_t
    current_lpc <- lpc_t
    previous_output <- output_t
    current_labour <- labour_t
    
    # Save
    results[[as.character(year)]] <- data.frame(
      YEAR = year,
      SECTOR = gdp_baseline$SECTOR,
      CATEGORY = gdp_baseline$CATEGORY,
      LAND_REQUIREMENT = land_req_t,
      LPC = lpc_t,
      FD = fd_t,
      FD_EFFECTIVE = fd_effective,
      INTENSITY = intensity_vec,
      PROP_FD = prop_fd_t,
      OUTPUT = output_t,
      GDP = gdp_t,
      INCOME = income_t,
      LABOUR = labour_t,
      SURPLUS = surplus_t,
      OUTPUT_MULTIPLIER = output_multiplier_t,
      ITFL = itfl_t,
      ITBL = itbl_t,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  final_result <- do.call(rbind, results)
  final_result <- final_result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        where(is.numeric),
        ~ ifelse(!is.finite(.x), 0, .x)
      )
    )
  
  return(final_result)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# 6. SIAPKAN AREA MATRIX
# =====================================================

projection_long <- projection_area |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, LC),
    names_to = "YEAR",
    values_to = "AREA"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR))

create_area_matrix <- function(projection_long) {
  years <- sort(unique(projection_long$YEAR))
  ids <- sort(unique(projection_long$ID))
  area_matrix <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(ids),
    ncol = length(years),
    dimnames = list(ids, years)
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(projection_long))) {
    area_matrix[
      as.character(projection_long$ID[i]),
      as.character(projection_long$YEAR[i])
    ] <- projection_long$AREA[i]
  }
  area_matrix
}

area_matrix <- create_area_matrix(projection_long)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# 7. LOAD SCENARIO INPUTS & RUN ALL PROJECTIONS
# =====================================================

load_scenario_inputs <- function(sc_input, P_default, growth_rate) {
  
  # Land distribution
  if (!is.null(sc_input$land_distribution) && file.exists(sc_input$land_distribution)) {
    land_prop_sc <- readxl::read_excel(sc_input$land_distribution) |> as.data.frame()
    first_sector_col <- min(grep("^S\\d+", colnames(land_prop_sc)))
    P_sc <- as.matrix(land_prop_sc[, first_sector_col:ncol(land_prop_sc)])
  } else {
    P_sc <- P_default
  }
  storage.mode(P_sc) <- "numeric"
  
  # Growth rate
  if (!is.null(sc_input$growth_rate) && file.exists(sc_input$growth_rate)) {
    growth_rate_sc <- readxl::read_excel(sc_input$growth_rate) |> as.data.frame()
  } else {
    growth_rate_sc <- growth_rate
  }
  
  # LPC Productivity
  if (!is.null(sc_input$lpc) && file.exists(sc_input$lpc)) {
    lpc_sc <- readxl::read_excel(sc_input$lpc) |> as.data.frame()
    lpc_sc$Increment_Rate <- as.numeric(lpc_sc$Increment_Rate)
    lpc_sc$Area_Implemented <- as.numeric(lpc_sc$Area_Implemented) / 100
  } else {
    lpc_sc <- NULL
  }
  
  # IO Changes
  if (!is.null(sc_input$io_changes) && file.exists(sc_input$io_changes)) {
    io_sc <- readxl::read_excel(sc_input$io_changes) |> as.data.frame()
    io_sc$Change_Pct <- as.numeric(io_sc$Change_Pct) / 100
  } else {
    io_sc <- NULL
  }
  
  # Intensity
  if (!is.null(sc_input$intensity) && file.exists(sc_input$intensity)) {
    int_sc <- readxl::read_excel(sc_input$intensity) |> as.data.frame()
    int_sc$Intensity <- as.numeric(int_sc$Intensity) / 100
  } else {
    int_sc <- NULL
  }
  
  return(list(
    P = P_sc,
    growth_rate = growth_rate_sc,
    lpc_scenario = lpc_sc,
    io_changes = io_sc,
    intensity_table = int_sc
  ))
}

# ==========================================
# RUN BAU
# ==========================================
message("Menjalankan proyeksi BAU...")
projection_bau <- run_projection(
  gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
  income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
  labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
  SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
  output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
  linkage_table       = linkage_table,
  leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
  full_io_table       = full_io_table,
  sector_idx          = sector_idx,
  P                   = P_default,
  area_matrix         = area_matrix,
  growth_rate         = growth_rate,
  lpc_scenario        = NULL,
  io_changes          = NULL,
  intensity_table     = NULL
)
projection_bau$SCENARIO <- "BAU"

all_projections <- list(BAU = projection_bau)

# ==========================================
# RUN SCENARIOS (JIKA MODE SCENARIO)
# ==========================================
if (params$mode == "Scenario" && !is.null(scenario_inputs)) {
  for (s in seq_along(scenario_inputs)) {
    message("Menjalankan proyeksi Skenario ", s, "/", n_scenarios, "...")
    
    sc_input <- load_scenario_inputs(scenario_inputs[[s]], P_default, growth_rate)
    
    projection_sc <- run_projection(
      gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
      income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
      labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
      SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
      output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
      linkage_table       = linkage_table,
      leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
      full_io_table       = full_io_table,
      sector_idx          = sector_idx,
      P                   = sc_input$P,
      area_matrix         = area_matrix,
      growth_rate         = sc_input$growth_rate,
      lpc_scenario        = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
      io_changes          = sc_input$io_changes,
      intensity_table     = sc_input$intensity_table
    )
    
    projection_sc$SCENARIO <- paste0("Skenario_", s)
    all_projections[[paste0("Skenario_", s)]] <- projection_sc
  }
}

# Gabungkan semua
projection_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_projections)
rownames(projection_combined) <- NULL

# Backward compatibility
projection_result <- projection_bau

message("Semua proyeksi selesai. Total: ", length(all_projections), " skenario.")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# 8. FUNGSI PLOT & TABEL KOMPARASI
# =====================================================

plot_comparison <- function(data, value_col, title, y_label) {
  n_scenarios <- length(unique(data$SCENARIO))
  
  if (n_scenarios > 1) {
    ggplot(data, aes(x = YEAR, y = .data[[value_col]], color = SCENARIO)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(data$YEAR)) +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
      labs(title = title, x = "Tahun", y = y_label, color = "Skenario") +
      theme_minimal()
  } else {
    ggplot(data, aes(x = YEAR, y = .data[[value_col]])) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#4472C4") +
      geom_point(size = 3, color = "#4472C4") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(data$YEAR)) +
      labs(title = title, x = "Tahun", y = y_label) +
      theme_minimal()
  }
}

create_comparison_table <- function(data, value_col) {
  data |>
    dplyr::select(YEAR, SCENARIO, dplyr::all_of(value_col)) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = SCENARIO,
      values_from = dplyr::all_of(value_col)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(YEAR)
}

interpret_projection <- function(data, value_col, indicator_name) {
  first_value <- data[[value_col]][1]
  last_value <- data[[value_col]][nrow(data)]
  change_pct <- (last_value - first_value) / first_value * 100
  trend <- ifelse(change_pct > 0, "meningkat", "menurun")
  cat(paste0(
    "Selama periode proyeksi, ", indicator_name,
    " menunjukkan tren ", trend, " sebesar ",
    round(abs(change_pct), 2),
    "% dibandingkan tahun awal proyeksi."
  ))
}
```

## Proyeksi PDRB (IDR/Tahun)
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gdp_comparison <- projection_combined |>
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR, SCENARIO) |>
  dplyr::summarise(GDP = sum(GDP), .groups = "drop")

gdp_base <- data.frame(
  YEAR = initial_year,
  SCENARIO = unique(gdp_comparison$SCENARIO),
  GDP = sum(gdp_baseline$GDP)
)

gdp_comparison <- rbind(gdp_base, gdp_comparison) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SCENARIO, YEAR)

gdp_wide <- create_comparison_table(gdp_comparison, "GDP")

DT::datatable(gdp_wide, rownames = FALSE, 
  caption = "Perbandingan PDRB per Skenario (IDR/Tahun)") %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = 2:ncol(gdp_wide), digits = 2, mark = ",")

plot_comparison(gdp_comparison, "GDP", "Perbandingan Proyeksi PDRB", "IDR/Tahun")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# TEMPLATE EXCEL UNTUK 5 INPUT SKENARIO
# =====================================================

create_scenario_templates <- function(
    gdp_baseline,
    code_registry,
    initial_year,
    end_year,
    time_step,
    output_path = "Scenario_Input_Templates.xlsx"
) {
  
  if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'openxlsx' diperlukan. Install dengan: install.packages('openxlsx')")
  }
  
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  
  # ==========================================
  # AMBIL DATA SEKTOR DENGAN AMAN
  # ==========================================
  
  # gdp_baseline TIDAK punya kolom Sector_Code
  # Buat kode sektor dari nomor baris
  n_sectors <- nrow(gdp_baseline)
  
  if (n_sectors == 0) {
    stop("gdp_baseline kosong. Periksa file IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx sheet GDP.")
  }
  
  sector_codes <- as.character(1:n_sectors)
  sector_names <- as.character(gdp_baseline$SECTOR)
  
  message("Jumlah sektor: ", n_sectors)
  message("Contoh nama sektor: ", paste(head(sector_names, 5), collapse = ", "))
  
  # ==========================================
  # STYLES
  # ==========================================
  header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fontColour = "#FFFFFF",
    fgFill = "#4472C4",
    halign = "CENTER",
    textDecoration = "bold",
    border = "TopBottomLeftRight",
    borderColour = "#1F3864"
  )
  
  editable_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fgFill = "#FFF2CC",
    border = "TopBottomLeftRight"
  )
  
  info_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fgFill = "#D9D9D9",
    border = "TopBottomLeftRight"
  )
  
  title_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fontSize = 12,
    textDecoration = "bold",
    fgFill = "#2F5496",
    fontColour = "#FFFFFF"
  )
  
  # ==========================================
  # PERIODE
  # ==========================================
  periods_df <- create_period_table(initial_year, end_year, time_step)
  years_proj <- seq(initial_year + time_step, end_year, by = time_step)
  n_periods <- nrow(periods_df)
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 1: README
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "README")
  
  instructions_text <- c(
    "PETUNJUK PENGISIAN TEMPLATE SKENARIO",
    "",
    "CATATAN PENTING:",
    "  - Kode sektor (Sector_Code) adalah NOMOR BARIS sektor di sheet GDP (1, 2, 3, ...)",
    "  - Lihat sheet Code_Registry_Ref untuk daftar lengkap kode dan nama sektor",
    "",
    "Sheet 1_Luasan_Lahan (WAJIB)",
    "  - Format: ID, LC, dan tahun-tahun proyeksi",
    "  - Nilai dalam hektar",
    "",
    "Sheet 2_Distribusi_Lahan (Opsional)",
    "  - Proporsi distribusi lahan (0-1) per Land Cover ke setiap sektor",
    "  - Total per kolom sektor HARUS = 1",
    "",
    "Sheet 3_Growth_Rate (Opsional)",
    "  - Kolom: Sector_Code, Sector, Growth_Rate",
    "  - Growth_Rate dalam desimal (misal 0.035 untuk 3.5%)",
    "",
    "Sheet 4_Produktivitas_LPC (Opsional)",
    "  - Crop_Type: 'annual' (semusim) atau 'perennial' (tahunan)",
    "",
    "Sheet 5_Perubahan_IO (Opsional)",
    "  - Row_Code & Col_Code: kode baris/kolom pada Full IO Table",
    "  - Change_Pct: persentase perubahan (10 = +10%, -5 = -5%)",
    "",
    "Sheet Code_Registry_Ref (Referensi)",
    "  - Daftar lengkap kode sektor dan komponen IO",
    "",
    "Sheet 6_Intensitas (Opsional)",
    "  - Intensity: 0-100, seberapa besar efek skenario diterapkan"
  )
  
  instructions <- data.frame(
    No = seq_along(instructions_text),
    Keterangan = instructions_text,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "README", instructions, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "README", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:2, gridExpand = TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "README", cols = 1, widths = 6)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "README", cols = 2, widths = 95)
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 2: LUASAN LAHAN (WAJIB)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan")
  
  n_lc_example <- 5
  
  luasan_list <- list(
    ID = 1:n_lc_example,
    LC = c("Sawah Irigasi", "Sawah Tadah Hujan", "Kebun Campuran", "Hutan", "Permukiman")
  )
  
  for (yr in years_proj) {
    luasan_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- rep(0, n_lc_example)
  }
  
  luasan_template <- as.data.frame(luasan_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  n_col_luasan <- ncol(luasan_template)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", 
    "Sheet WAJIB — Isi luas lahan (hektar) untuk setiap Land Cover di setiap tahun proyeksi",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", cols = 1:n_col_luasan, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", luasan_template, startRow = 3, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", header_style, rows = 3, cols = 1:n_col_luasan, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", info_style,
    rows = 4:(n_lc_example + 3), cols = 1:2, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  if (n_col_luasan > 2) {
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", editable_style,
      rows = 4:(n_lc_example + 3), cols = 3:n_col_luasan, gridExpand = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", cols = 1, widths = 8)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", cols = 2, widths = 24)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "1_Luasan_Lahan", cols = 3:n_col_luasan, widths = 14)
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 3: DISTRIBUSI LAHAN (OPSIONAL)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan")
  
  n_lc_dist <- 5
  
  # Nama kolom pendek: S1, S2, S3, ...
  short_sector_names <- paste0("S", sector_codes)
  
  dist_list <- list(
    ID = 1:n_lc_dist,
    LC = c("Sawah Irigasi", "Sawah Tadah Hujan", "Kebun Campuran", "Hutan", "Permukiman"),
    Land_Class = c("Agriculture", "Agriculture", "Agriculture", "Forest", "Settlement")
  )
  
  for (nm in short_sector_names) {
    dist_list[[nm]] <- rep(0, n_lc_dist)
  }
  
  distribusi_template <- as.data.frame(dist_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  n_col_dist <- ncol(distribusi_template)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan",
    "Sheet OPSIONAL — Isi proporsi distribusi lahan (0-1) per Land Cover ke setiap sektor. Total per kolom sektor HARUS = 1. Kosongkan jika ingin menggunakan baseline.",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 1:n_col_dist, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  # Legend dalam 1 baris
  legend_parts <- paste0(short_sector_names, "=", sector_names)
  legend_text <- paste0("LEGENDA: ", paste(legend_parts, collapse = " | "))
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", legend_text, startRow = 2, startCol = 1)
  
  data_start_row <- 4
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", distribusi_template, startRow = data_start_row, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", header_style, rows = data_start_row, cols = 1:n_col_dist, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", info_style,
    rows = (data_start_row + 1):(n_lc_dist + data_start_row), cols = 1:3, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", editable_style,
    rows = (data_start_row + 1):(n_lc_dist + data_start_row), cols = 4:n_col_dist, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 1, widths = 6)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 2, widths = 22)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 3, widths = 16)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 4:n_col_dist, widths = 10)
  
  # SUM check
  row_check <- n_lc_dist + data_start_row + 1
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", "TOTAL =", startRow = row_check, startCol = 1)
  
  for (col_idx in 4:n_col_dist) {
    col_letter <- openxlsx::int2col(col_idx)
    formula_text <- paste0("SUM(", col_letter, data_start_row + 1, ":", col_letter, row_check - 1, ")")
    openxlsx::writeFormula(wb, "2_Distribusi_Lahan", formula_text,
      startRow = row_check, startCol = col_idx
    )
  }
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 4: GROWTH RATE (OPSIONAL)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "3_Growth_Rate")
  
  growth_list <- list(
    Sector_Code = sector_codes,
    Sector = sector_names,
    Growth_Rate = rep(0.03, n_sectors)
  )
  
  growth_template <- as.data.frame(growth_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  n_row_growth <- nrow(growth_template)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "3_Growth_Rate",
    "Sheet OPSIONAL — Isi laju pertumbuhan per sektor (desimal). Contoh: 0.035 = 3.5% per tahun. Kosongkan/hapus jika ingin menggunakan baseline dari IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx.",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", cols = 1:3, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", growth_template, startRow = 3, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", header_style, rows = 3, cols = 1:3, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", info_style,
    rows = 4:(n_row_growth + 3), cols = 1:2, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", editable_style,
    rows = 4:(n_row_growth + 3), cols = 3, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", cols = 1, widths = 14)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", cols = 2, widths = 50)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "3_Growth_Rate", cols = 3, widths = 16)
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 5: PRODUKTIVITAS LPC (OPSIONAL)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC")
  
  example_n <- min(3, n_sectors)
  lpc_sector_codes <- sector_codes[1:example_n]
  lpc_sector_names <- sector_names[1:example_n]
  n_row_lpc <- example_n * n_periods
  
  lpc_list <- list(
    Sector_Code = rep(lpc_sector_codes, each = n_periods),
    Sector = rep(lpc_sector_names, each = n_periods),
    Start_Year = rep(periods_df$Start_Year, example_n),
    End_Year = rep(periods_df$End_Year, example_n),
    Increment_Rate = rep(0.02, n_row_lpc),
    Area_Implemented = rep(50, n_row_lpc),
    Crop_Type = rep("annual", n_row_lpc)
  )
  
  lpc_template <- as.data.frame(lpc_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC",
    "Sheet OPSIONAL — Isi skenario peningkatan produktivitas. Crop_Type: 'annual' (semusim) atau 'perennial' (tahunan). Hapus baris contoh jika tidak digunakan.",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", cols = 1:7, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", "RUMUS:", startRow = 2, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC",
    "LPC Baru = LPC_current + (LPC_current x LPC_Growth_Rate)",
    startRow = 3, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC",
    "Annual   : LPC_Growth_Rate = Increment_Rate x (Area_Implemented/100)",
    startRow = 4, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC",
    "Perennial: LPC_Growth_Rate = SUM(semua Increment_Rate s/d periode ini) x (Area_Implemented/100)",
    startRow = 5, startCol = 1
  )
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", lpc_template, startRow = 7, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", header_style, rows = 7, cols = 1:7, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", info_style,
    rows = 8:(n_row_lpc + 7), cols = 1:4, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", editable_style,
    rows = 8:(n_row_lpc + 7), cols = 5:7, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", cols = 1:2, widths = 14)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", cols = 3:4, widths = 12)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", cols = 5:6, widths = 18)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC", cols = 7, widths = 14)
  
  if (n_row_lpc > 0) {
    openxlsx::dataValidation(wb, "4_Produktivitas_LPC",
      cols = 7,
      rows = 8:(n_row_lpc + 7),
      type = "list",
      value = '"annual,perennial"'
    )
  }
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 6: PERUBAHAN IO TABLE (OPSIONAL)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO")
  
  n_io_example <- 3
  
  io_list <- list(
    Start_Year = rep(periods_df$Start_Year[1], n_io_example),
    End_Year = rep(periods_df$End_Year[1], n_io_example),
    Row_Code = c(5, 12, 8),
    Row_Description = rep("(isi deskripsi)", n_io_example),
    Col_Code = c(8, 3, 15),
    Col_Description = rep("(isi deskripsi)", n_io_example),
    Change_Pct = c(10, -5, 20)
  )
  
  io_template <- as.data.frame(io_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO",
    "Sheet OPSIONAL — Isi perubahan persentase pada sel Full IO Table. Change_Pct positif = kenaikan, negatif = penurunan. Lihat sheet Code_Registry_Ref untuk referensi Row_Code dan Col_Code.",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 1:7, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", io_template, startRow = 3, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", header_style, rows = 3, cols = 1:7, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", editable_style,
    rows = 4:(n_io_example + 3), cols = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7), gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", info_style,
    rows = 4:(n_io_example + 3), cols = c(4, 6), gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 1:2, widths = 12)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 3, widths = 14)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 4, widths = 20)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 5, widths = 14)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 6, widths = 20)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "5_Perubahan_IO", cols = 7, widths = 16)
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 7: CODE REGISTRY (REFERENSI)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref")
  
  # Buat tabel referensi sektor dari gdp_baseline
  ref_table <- data.frame(
    Row_Index = 1:n_sectors,
    Sector_Code = sector_codes,
    Sector_Name = sector_names,
    Category = gdp_baseline$CATEGORY,
    Type = "Sector",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Jika code_registry ada dan tidak kosong, gunakan itu
  if (!is.null(code_registry) && nrow(code_registry) > 0) {
    ref_table <- code_registry
  }
  
  n_col_ref <- ncol(ref_table)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref",
    "REFERENSI — Daftar kode sektor dan komponen IO. Gunakan Row_Index untuk mengisi Row_Code dan Col_Code pada sheet 5_Perubahan_IO.",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref", cols = 1:n_col_ref, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref", ref_table, startRow = 3, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref", header_style, rows = 3, cols = 1:n_col_ref, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "Code_Registry_Ref", cols = 1:n_col_ref, widths = 20)
  
  # ==========================================
  # SHEET 8: INTENSITAS IMPLEMENTASI (OPSIONAL)
  # ==========================================
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "6_Intensitas")
  
  example_n_int <- min(3, n_sectors)
  int_sector_codes <- sector_codes[1:example_n_int]
  int_sector_names <- sector_names[1:example_n_int]
  n_row_intensity <- example_n_int * n_periods
  
  int_list <- list(
    Sector_Code = rep(int_sector_codes, each = n_periods),
    Sector = rep(int_sector_names, each = n_periods),
    Start_Year = rep(periods_df$Start_Year, example_n_int),
    End_Year = rep(periods_df$End_Year, example_n_int),
    Intensity = rep(100, n_row_intensity)
  )
  
  intensity_template <- as.data.frame(int_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "6_Intensitas",
    "Sheet OPSIONAL — Isi intensitas implementasi skenario per sektor per periode (0-100). 100 = skenario diterapkan penuh, 0 = tidak ada efek (kembali ke baseline). Hapus baris contoh jika tidak digunakan.",
    startRow = 1, startCol = 1
  )
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "6_Intensitas", cols = 1:5, rows = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "6_Intensitas", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "6_Intensitas",
    "Rumus: FD_effective = FD_baseline + (Intensity/100) x (FD_skenario - FD_baseline)",
    startRow = 2, startCol = 1
  )
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "6_Intensitas", intensity_template, startRow = 4, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "6_Intensitas", header_style, rows = 4, cols = 1:5, gridExpand = TRUE)
  
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "6_Intensitas", info_style,
    rows = 5:(n_row_intensity + 4), cols = 1:4, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "6_Intensitas", editable_style,
    rows = 5:(n_row_intensity + 4), cols = 5, gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "6_Intensitas", cols = 1:2, widths = 14)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "6_Intensitas", cols = 3:4, widths = 12)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "6_Intensitas", cols = 5, widths = 14)
  
  if (n_row_intensity > 0) {
    openxlsx::dataValidation(wb, "6_Intensitas",
      cols = 5,
      rows = 5:(n_row_intensity + 4),
      type = "whole",
      operator = "between",
      value = c(0, 100)
    )
  }
  
  # ==========================================
  # SIMPAN
  # ==========================================
  message("Menyimpan workbook...")
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, output_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  message("Template berhasil disimpan di: ", normalizePath(output_path))
  return(output_path)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=params$mode=="BAU"}
# =====================================================
# 9. TEMPLATE UTAMA + FILE PER SKENARIO (HANYA MODE BAU)
# =====================================================

message("Mode BAU: Menghasilkan template untuk ", n_scenarios, " skenario...")

# ==========================================
# A. TEMPLATE UTAMA (Scenario_Input_Templates.xlsx)
# ==========================================
create_scenario_templates(
  gdp_baseline  = gdp_baseline,
  code_registry = code_registry,
  initial_year  = initial_year,
  end_year      = end_year,
  time_step     = time_step,
  output_path   = "data/Scenario_Input_Templates.xlsx"
)

# ==========================================
# B. FILE INPUT PER SKENARIO (ANGKA REALISTIS)
# ==========================================
n_sectors <- nrow(gdp_baseline)
sector_codes <- as.character(1:n_sectors)
sector_names <- as.character(gdp_baseline$SECTOR)
n_periods <- length(seq(initial_year + time_step, end_year, by = time_step))
periods_df <- create_period_table(initial_year, end_year, time_step)
lc_list <- projection_area[, c("ID", "LC")]
n_lc <- nrow(lc_list)

# Ambil growth rate baseline untuk referensi
if (!is.null(growth_rate) && ncol(growth_rate) >= 1) {
  r_baseline <- as.numeric(growth_rate[[1]])
} else {
  r_baseline <- rep(0.03, n_sectors)
}

header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
  fontColour = "#FFFFFF", fgFill = "#4472C4", halign = "CENTER",
  textDecoration = "bold", border = "TopBottomLeftRight"
)

# Tema untuk setiap skenario (agar hasilnya berbeda tapi masuk akal)
scenario_themes <- list(
  list(
    nama = "Pertanian Maju",
    deskripsi = "Fokus pada peningkatan produktivitas pertanian dan agroindustri",
    growth_modifier = c(1.3, 1.2, 1.1, rep(1.0, n_sectors-3)),  # sektor awal naik
    intensitas_awal = 80,
    intensitas_trend = "naik",
    lpc_fokus = c(1, 2),       # sektor 1-2 (pertanian)
    io_change_fokus = c(1, 3)   # intermediate dari sektor 1 ke 3
  ),
  list(
    nama = "Industri Hilir",
    deskripsi = "Fokus pada industrialisasi dan pengolahan",
    growth_modifier = c(rep(1.0, 3), 1.4, 1.3, 1.2, rep(1.0, n_sectors-6)),
    intensitas_awal = 60,
    intensitas_trend = "naik",
    lpc_fokus = c(3, 4),       # sektor 3-4 (industri)
    io_change_fokus = c(3, 5)   # intermediate dari sektor 3 ke 5
  ),
  list(
    nama = "Jasa & Perdagangan",
    deskripsi = "Fokus pada sektor jasa dan perdagangan",
    growth_modifier = c(rep(1.0, 5), 1.3, 1.2, rep(1.0, n_sectors-7)),
    intensitas_awal = 70,
    intensitas_trend = "stabil",
    lpc_fokus = c(5, 6),
    io_change_fokus = c(5, 7)
  )
)

for (s in 1:n_scenarios) {
  
  # Pilih tema (cycling jika n_scenarios > jumlah tema)
  tema <- scenario_themes[[(s - 1) %% length(scenario_themes) + 1]]
  
  sc_folder <- paste0("data/scenario/scenario", s)
  dir.create(sc_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  message("  Membuat template Skenario ", s, ": ", tema$nama, "...")
  
  # Pastikan growth_modifier sesuai panjangnya
  gm <- rep(1.0, n_sectors)
  gm[1:min(length(tema$growth_modifier), n_sectors)] <- tema$growth_modifier[1:min(length(tema$growth_modifier), n_sectors)]
  
  # ========================================
  # 1. DISTRIBUSI LAHAN
  # ========================================
  wb1 <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb1, "Distribusi_Lahan")
  
  short_sector_names <- paste0("S", sector_codes)
  dist_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_lc, ncol = n_sectors)
  colnames(dist_mat) <- short_sector_names
  
  set.seed(100 + s)
  
  # Fokuskan distribusi ke sektor-sektor tertentu sesuai tema
  sektor_fokus <- tema$lpc_fokus
  for (j in sektor_fokus) {
    if (j <= n_sectors) {
      dist_mat[, j] <- runif(n_lc, 0.3, 0.7)  # nilai lebih tinggi untuk sektor fokus
    }
  }
  
  # Sektor lain dapat nilai kecil
  sektor_lain <- setdiff(1:n_sectors, sektor_fokus)
  for (j in sektor_lain) {
    dist_mat[, j] <- runif(n_lc, 0, 0.15)
  }
  
  # Normalisasi
  for (i in 1:n_lc) {
    row_sum <- sum(dist_mat[i, ])
    if (row_sum > 0) dist_mat[i, ] <- round(dist_mat[i, ] / row_sum, 4)
  }
  
  dist_df <- data.frame(
    ID = lc_list$ID, LC = lc_list$LC, Land_Class = rep("Mixed", n_lc),
    dist_mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb1, "Distribusi_Lahan", dist_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb1, "Distribusi_Lahan", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(dist_df), gridExpand = TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb1, "Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 1:3, widths = c(6, 24, 16))
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb1, "Distribusi_Lahan", cols = 4:ncol(dist_df), widths = 10)
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb1, "Distribusi_Lahan", firstCol = TRUE, firstRow = TRUE)
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb1, file.path(sc_folder, "distribusi_lahan.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # ========================================
  # 2. GROWTH RATE (realistis: 2-6%, berbeda per skenario)
  # ========================================
  wb2 <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb2, "Growth_Rate")
  set.seed(200 + s)
  
  # Growth rate = baseline * modifier dengan sedikit noise
  growth_rates <- r_baseline * gm * runif(n_sectors, 0.9, 1.1)
  growth_rates <- round(pmin(growth_rates, 0.07), 4)  # cap 7%
  
  growth_df <- data.frame(
    Sector_Code = sector_codes,
    Sector = sector_names,
    Growth_Rate = growth_rates,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb2, "Growth_Rate", growth_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb2, "Growth_Rate", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:3, gridExpand = TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb2, "Growth_Rate", cols = 1:3, widths = c(14, 50, 16))
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb2, file.path(sc_folder, "growth_rate.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # ========================================
  # 3. PRODUKTIVITAS LPC
  # ========================================
  wb3 <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb3, "Produktivitas_LPC")
  
  lpc_fokus <- tema$lpc_fokus
  lpc_fokus <- lpc_fokus[lpc_fokus <= n_sectors]
  n_lpc_sectors <- length(lpc_fokus)
  
  if (n_lpc_sectors > 0) {
    # Increment rate realistis: 0.5% - 3% per periode
    increment_pattern <- seq(0.005, 0.03, length.out = n_periods)
    area_pattern <- seq(30, 80, length.out = n_periods)  # 30% → 80% coverage
    
    lpc_df <- data.frame(
      Sector_Code = rep(sector_codes[lpc_fokus], each = n_periods),
      Sector = rep(sector_names[lpc_fokus], each = n_periods),
      Start_Year = rep(periods_df$Start_Year, n_lpc_sectors),
      End_Year = rep(periods_df$End_Year, n_lpc_sectors),
      Increment_Rate = rep(increment_pattern, n_lpc_sectors),
      Area_Implemented = rep(area_pattern, n_lpc_sectors),
      Crop_Type = rep("annual", n_lpc_sectors * n_periods),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    openxlsx::writeData(wb3, "Produktivitas_LPC", lpc_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb3, "Produktivitas_LPC", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:7, gridExpand = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(wb3, "Produktivitas_LPC", cols = 1:7, widths = c(14, 14, 12, 12, 18, 18, 14))
  } else {
    openxlsx::writeData(wb3, "Produktivitas_LPC", 
      data.frame(Info = "Tidak ada sektor fokus LPC untuk skenario ini"),
      startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  }
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb3, file.path(sc_folder, "produktivitas_lpc.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # ========================================
  # 4. PERUBAHAN IO (realistis: ±5-15%)
  # ========================================
  wb4 <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb4, "Perubahan_IO")
  
  io_fokus <- tema$io_change_fokus
  n_io <- min(3, n_periods)
  
  io_list <- list()
  for (p in 1:n_io) {
    if (length(io_fokus) >= 2 && io_fokus[1] <= n_sectors && io_fokus[2] <= n_sectors) {
      io_list[[length(io_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Start_Year = periods_df$Start_Year[p],
        End_Year = periods_df$End_Year[p],
        Row_Code = io_fokus[1],
        Col_Code = io_fokus[2],
        Change_Pct = round(5 + (s * 3) + p * 2, 1),  # 7% - 16% range
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(io_list) > 0) {
    io_df <- do.call(rbind, io_list)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb4, "Perubahan_IO", io_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb4, "Perubahan_IO", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:5, gridExpand = TRUE)
  } else {
    openxlsx::writeData(wb4, "Perubahan_IO",
      data.frame(Info = "Tidak ada perubahan IO untuk skenario ini"),
      startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  }
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb4, "Perubahan_IO", cols = 1:5, widths = c(12, 12, 14, 14, 16))
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb4, file.path(sc_folder, "perubahan_io.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # ========================================
  # 5. INTENSITAS (realistis: bertahap)
  # ========================================
  wb5 <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb5, "Intensitas")
  
  n_int_sectors <- min(8, n_sectors)
  n_row_intensity <- n_int_sectors * n_periods
  
  if (tema$intensitas_trend == "naik") {
    # Intensitas naik dari 50 ke 95
    base_intensity <- seq(tema$intensitas_awal, 95, length.out = n_periods)
  } else if (tema$intensitas_trend == "turun") {
    base_intensity <- seq(tema$intensitas_awal, 30, length.out = n_periods)
  } else {
    # stabil
    base_intensity <- rep(tema$intensitas_awal, n_periods)
  }
  
  intensity_values <- rep(base_intensity, n_int_sectors)
  
  # Variasi kecil per sektor
  set.seed(300 + s)
  intensity_values <- intensity_values * runif(n_row_intensity, 0.9, 1.1)
  intensity_values <- round(intensity_values)
  intensity_values[intensity_values > 100] <- 100
  intensity_values[intensity_values < 10] <- 10
  
  int_df <- data.frame(
    Sector_Code = rep(sector_codes[1:n_int_sectors], each = n_periods),
    Sector = rep(sector_names[1:n_int_sectors], each = n_periods),
    Start_Year = rep(periods_df$Start_Year, n_int_sectors),
    End_Year = rep(periods_df$End_Year, n_int_sectors),
    Intensity = intensity_values,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  openxlsx::writeData(wb5, "Intensitas", int_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb5, "Intensitas", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:5, gridExpand = TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb5, "Intensitas", cols = 1:5, widths = c(14, 14, 12, 12, 14))
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb5, file.path(sc_folder, "intensitas.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  message("    Tema: ", tema$nama, " | Growth modifier: +", 
          round((mean(gm)-1)*100), "% | Intensitas: ", tema$intensitas_trend)
}

message("   Template untuk ", n_scenarios, " skenario berhasil dibuat")
message("   Folder: data/scenario/scenario1, scenario2, ...")
message("   Template utama: Scenario_Input_Templates.xlsx")
```
